text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If we want to minimize rule violations, we
need to
get to the bottom of the
problem...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hrm... But what can we do besides crack
down on
everyone? Do we get on our
knees and beg
them?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I could just talk with everyone
more and
raise awareness?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Although... If there were fewer rules,
maybe there
would be fewer violations.
No, but then there
wouldn't be any
discipline...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Well, might as well try everything!
Anyway, it's
about time for b—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What?! It's morning already?! What have
I done?!
